preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_role_permission rp INNER JOIN m_role r ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN m_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE r.name = 'Super user' AND p.code = 'UPDATE_EXCHANGE_RATE'

changeSet.comment: Assign UPDATE_EXCHANGE_RATE permission to Super User role
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r, m_permission p WHERE r.name = 'Super user' AND p.code = 'UPDATE_EXCHANGE_RATE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id );
